title: Tagged release workflow publishing signed APK to GitHub releases

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: GitHub releases are a chosen distribution channel. Builds should be reproducible from a tag rather than a laptop.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Trigger on `push: tags: ['v*']`. Run `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleRelease`, signing from repository secrets: a base64 keystore plus passwords. The owner creates these secrets; the slice only documents the names.
2. Attach `app-release.apk` and its SHA-256 to the release via `softprops/action-gh-release` (MIT) or the `gh release create` CLI. Prefer `gh`, since it's preinstalled on the runners.
3. Fail the workflow if the tag's version doesn't match `versionName`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Push a `v0.9.0-rc1` tag to a fork or test repo → the release appears with a signed APK that installs over a previous one.
